scope: Independent read-only review of two known synthetic diagnostics; not blind quality grading
source: The sample ledger lists seven matched invoices. Payment status is unknown. A controller must approve release.
flawed_positive_control: Sieben Rechnungen sind zugeordnet; Zahlungsstatus unklar. Freigabe nur durch den Controller.
finding: The source requires controller approval but does not make the controller the exclusive release authority. The purported positive control is stronger. V3 and v4 accept it, so both contain a semantic false-accept counterexample. The raw case label synthetic-valid is preserved, not endorsed.
v4_invalid_draft_repair: The raw one-key text envelope decodes exactly to the recorded repair, removes unsupported payment/automatic approval claims and retains unknown payment status and required controller approval. This supports the narrow typed repair path.
